variant.author: beerpsi
variant.changelog:
# MouseLock

MouseLock keeps FFXIV in mouselook until you actually need the cursor. It pauses for chat, bags, menus, and other UI, and can also turn LMB/RMB into configurable game inputs, hotbar actions, or MouseLock controls.
variant.description: A plugin to disable moving forward using LMB+RMB, with separate toggles for walking and flying.
variant.name: NoMouseMoveForward
variant.punchline: Plugin to disable moving forward with LMB+RMB
